morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来专名整体记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。正常书写首字母大写；所列 IPA 为法语读音，具体读法以本人为准。

senses.zh_definition: 伊莎贝尔：通常用作女性名字的外来专名。
senses.en_definition: Isabelle, a feminine given name used in French and several other languages.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, lazimnya nama perempuan, yang digunakan dalam bahasa Perancis dan beberapa bahasa lain.

etymology.historical_story: Isabelle is the French form of Isabel and belongs to the wider Elizabeth name family. Its ancestry ultimately reaches the Hebrew name Elisheva, traditionally interpreted in relation to God and an oath. These historical associations explain relationships among names; they do not function as a literal Malay definition of the person bearing the name. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/isabelle), [Elizabeth](https://www.behindthename.com/name/elizabeth)
